Wild Card Clinched by Astros
The <Houston Astros:team#12> say they are ready for the challenge that lies ahead.

The challenge is to capture a World Series title as a wild card team.

"The American League West Division is a strong division and we still feel good about our chances even though we didn't win it," said closer <Josh Hader:player#32868>. "It's going to be a tougher road to a title, but it's one we're ready to embark on."

The team has a 84-70 record and is seeking its 3rd Major League Baseball championship.
